relations.subject: William King
relations.evidence: Son of William King (1809–1886, the Geologist, who in 1863 proposed that  Homo neanderthalensis  is a different species)

relations.subject: William King
relations.evidence: Studied civil engineering at Queen’s College in Galway

relations.subject: William King
relations.evidence: In 1857 joined the Geological Survey of India. Worked in South India and Chota Nagpur, then from 1887 as director of the Survey in Calcutta. Retired after several extensions in 1894.
